button.needXp: Not enough XP to level up ({needed} more needed)
button.levelLocked: Use the Level-Up Wizard to change your level

header.levelJump: The level was raised from {previousLevel} to {targetLevel} in one step. Choices for every level in between are shown together.

menu.nothingToChoose: There is nothing to choose at this level. Check the summary and apply the level-up.

single.title: Make your level {level} choices
single.subtitle: You choose {list}. Everything else is applied for you.

feats.title: Choose your level {level} feats
feats.missedHint: These slots were never filled. They're optional: fill any you like now.

skillIncreases.label: Skill to increase
skillIncreases.hint: Raise one skill by one rank. At this level a skill can reach {rank}.

attributeBoosts.label: Boost {count} different attributes
attributeBoosts.gradualLabel: Gradual boosts: boost {count} attribute(s) from the level {set} set
attributeBoosts.halfRule: Already +4 or higher? A boost counts as half until the next one.
attributeBoosts.manual: This character uses manually entered attribute modifiers, so the wizard skips attribute boosts. Update them on the character sheet.

intBonus.header: Intelligence went up: train one more skill
intBonus.hint: Only untrained skills are shown. The dots show the rank ladder: trained, expert, master, legendary.

languages.hint: Pick now or decide later: you can add languages on the character sheet at any time.

class.hint: These are added to your character automatically.

features.nothingByHand: Nothing needs updating by hand at level {level}.

confirmDialog.skipped: These choices are left empty and can be filled in later on the character sheet:

spells.managed: Slots and spells are kept up to date in {entry}.
spells.setupHint: {className} spellcasting isn't set up by the module yet. Set it up to get the entry, its slots and your spells added automatically.
spells.noPicks: No spells to choose at this level: you prepare from the full list each day.
spells.signatureHint: Choose one spell of each rank. You can cast a signature spell heightened to any rank you have slots for.
spells.signatureAll: Every spell in your repertoire is a signature spell; new ones are marked for you.

selector.title: {group} · level {level} · {actorName}
selector.pickHint: Pick a feat on the left to read it here. Double-click a feat to choose it straight away.
selector.hiddenNote: The GM hides some feat rarities.

prerequisites.unknown: Some prerequisites can't be checked automatically
prerequisites.dedicationRule: Two other feats from your {dedication} archetype first (you have {count})

history.title: Level-Up History
history.undoConfirm: Undo the last level-up of {actorName}? The feats and spells it added are removed and the level goes back from {fromLevel} to {toLevel}. Skill ranks, attribute boosts, languages, spell slots and XP are restored.
history.undoConfirmManual: Undo the last level-up of {actorName}? The feats and spells it added are removed, and skill ranks, attribute boosts, languages, spell slots and XP are restored. The level stays at {fromLevel} because it was changed by hand.
history.undoConfirmBuild: Undo the character build of {actorName}? Everything the builder added is removed: ancestry, heritage, background, class, deity, feats, spellcasting, trained skills, boosts and languages.

review.title: Review level {level}
review.subtitle: This is everything that will change on {actorName}.
review.halfBoost: {attribute} stays {mod} · half boost, rises with the next one
review.nothingByHand: Nothing left to do by hand
review.nothingByHandHint: New class features are added automatically. No spellcasting to update.
review.byHandHint: The same list is whispered to you in chat after applying.
review.safeHint: Everything is applied in one step. Changed your mind later? Undo it from the level-up history.

showButton.name: Enable Level-Up Button
showButton.hint: Show a Level-Up button on character sheets. When disabled, the wizard opens automatically after a character's level is raised manually.

buttonPlacement.name: Level-Up Button Placement
buttonPlacement.hint: Where the Level-Up button appears: next to the character's level, or in the window's header.

sortMethod.name: Feat Sorting
sortMethod.hint: How feats are sorted by default in the feat picker.

prerequisiteMode.name: Prerequisite Checking
prerequisiteMode.hint: Check feat prerequisites against the character and mark each feat as met, not met, or not checkable. Checks are a guide only: nothing is blocked.

hideUnmetPrerequisites.name: Hide Feats with Unmet Prerequisites
hideUnmetPrerequisites.hint: Default for the feat picker's "hide unmet prerequisites" filter. Feats whose prerequisites can't be checked are always shown.

skillInfo.name: Skill Increase Info
skillInfo.hint: How much information to show in skill selections.

options.nameWithModAndRank: Name, modifier and rank change (Nature +12 (Expert → Master))

disableLevelInput.name: Lock Level Field
disableLevelInput.hint: Disable the level field on character sheets so the wizard is the way to level up. Applies even when the XP requirement isn't met.

requireAllChoices.name: Require All Choices
requireAllChoices.hint: When enabled, every feat slot, skill increase and boost must be chosen before applying a level-up. Disable to let players leave choices empty and fill them in later.

allowPlayerUndo.name: Allow Players to Undo Level-Ups
allowPlayerUndo.hint: When enabled, players can undo their character's most recent level-up. The GM can always undo.

sendGMWhispers.name: Send Reminder Whispers to GM
sendGMWhispers.hint: Also whisper the reminders about manual updates (such as spell slots) to the GM.

additionalCompendiums.name: Additional Feat Compendiums
additionalCompendiums.hint: Feats come from every compendium selected in the system's Compendium Browser settings. Add other compendium IDs here as a comma-separated list, e.g. 'my-module.feats, world.homebrew-feats'.

hiddenRarities.name: Hidden Feat Rarities
hiddenRarities.hint: Feat rarities that players can't see in the feat picker.

options.uncommon: Hide uncommon, rare and unique feats

xpEnforcement.name: Enforce XP Requirements
xpEnforcement.hint: Only allow leveling up once the character has enough XP. The XP for the level is deducted and the rest carries over.

global.noChoices: No new choices at this level.

personal.spellRank: Rank {rank} spells are available: update spell slots and spells on the Spellcasting tab.
personal.featSpells: These new feats mention spells, cantrips or focus spells, which may need to be added by hand: {feats}.
personal.languages: You can learn {count} more language(s): add them on the character sheet.
personal.intSkill: Your Intelligence increase grants {count} additional trained skill(s): choose on the character sheet.
personal.emptySlots: Empty feat slots to fill on the character sheet: {slots}.

notifications.levelUpFailed: The level-up could not be prepared. See the console (F12) for details.
notifications.levelUpRolledBack: The level-up failed and was rolled back. See the console (F12) for details.
notifications.featsSkipped: Not added (choice cancelled): {feats}. Add them from the character sheet if needed.
notifications.missingClass: The Level-Up Wizard needs a class on the character.
notifications.companionClass: The Level-Up Wizard doesn't support companions or eidolons. Grant their feats manually.
notifications.incomplete: Make all the required choices first.
notifications.levelChanged: The character's level changed while the wizard was open. Open the wizard again.
notifications.cannotUndo: Only the most recent level-up can be undone, and only while the character is still level {level}.
notifications.settingsMigrated: Settings copied from the original PF2e Level-Up Wizard.

additionalCompendiums.failedToLoad: Could not load compendium {key}. Make sure it is a valid Item compendium.
additionalCompendiums.compendiumNotFound: Compendium {key} not found. Check the spelling in the Level-Up Wizard settings.

notifications.openFailed: The Level-Up Wizard could not open. See the console (F12) for details.
notifications.originalActive: The original "PF2e Level-Up Wizard" module is also active. Disable one of the two in Manage Modules, otherwise characters get two level-up buttons.

builder.stepOf: Step {number} of {count} · nothing is saved until the last step
builder.noResults: Nothing matches. Try another search or show more rarities.
builder.name: Name

ancestry.heading: Choose an ancestry
ancestry.hint: It sets your starting Hit Points, size, speed and some attribute boosts.

heritage.heading: Choose a heritage
heritage.hint: Heritages for {ancestry}, plus versatile heritages any ancestry can take.

background.heading: Choose a background
background.hint: Your background gives two attribute boosts, a trained skill and a skill feat.

class.heading: Choose a class
class.hint: Your class decides your role, key attribute and level-1 features.

boosts.heading: Attribute boosts
boosts.hint: Each row is one source of boosts. A row can boost each attribute only once.
boosts.alternateRule: Two free boosts instead of the ancestry's usual ones
boosts.keyNote: Your key attribute, {attribute}, is at {mod}. +4 is the most a level-1 character can have.

skills.heading: Trained skills
skills.hint: Choose {count} skills to become trained in: {cls} from your class and {int} from Intelligence.
skills.overlap: Your class and background train the same skill, so you pick {count} more instead.
skills.backgroundNote: Some backgrounds let you choose their skill; the system asks when the character is created.
skills.backgroundChoice: {background} trains one of these skills: choose it first

feats.heading: Level-1 feats
feats.hint: Your background's skill feat is added automatically.
feats.empty: No feats to choose at level 1 with these choices.

languages.heading: Languages and deity
languages.suggestedNote: Highlighted languages are the usual picks for your ancestry. Unpicked slots can be filled later on the sheet.

deity.heading: Deity
deity.required: Your class needs a deity: its level-1 features build on it.
deity.optional: Optional. You can follow a deity or none.

review.heading: Review your character
review.hint: This is everything that will be added to the sheet.
review.name: Name
review.replaces: These items already on the sheet will be replaced:
review.levelNote: The character is level {level}. Creating sets it to level 1; use the level-up wizard afterwards.
review.prompts: The system may ask a few follow-up questions while the character is created, such as your background's skill or your class's specialisation.
review.undo: You can undo this from the level-up history.
review.spellsPrepared: Prepared daily from the full list

notifications.failed: The character could not be created and the changes were undone. See the console (F12) for details.

spells.heading: Spells

hint.prepared: As a {className} you prepare spells. Pick the spells you start with; you prepare from them each day.
hint.spontaneous: As a {className} you cast spontaneously from your repertoire. Pick the spells you know.
hint.fullList: As a {className} you prepare spells each day from the full list of your tradition.

spells.traditionHint: A {className}'s tradition comes from a level-1 choice. Pick the one that matches it.
spells.slotNote: The spellcasting entry and its slots are added to the sheet for you, and kept up to date at each level-up.
spells.preparedNote: You prepare from every common spell of your tradition each day, so there is nothing to pick now. The entry and its slots are added for you.

spells.anyRank: Spells of any rank up to {rank}
spells.none: No spells match. Check the tradition or the compendium settings.

focus.title: Focus spells
focus.intro: Your new feats and class features give these focus spells. Untick any that don't apply, then add them to the sheet.
focus.failed: The focus spells could not be added; add them on the sheet.
focus.checkTooltip: Found from the feat's wording, not checked by hand. Make sure the spell applies.
focus.introCheck: Spells tagged "Check" were found from the feat's wording rather than checked by hand: read the quote and untick them if they don't apply.
